scientific_integrity: Analytic proof is provided for the infinite model; finite independent geometric and numerical checks are corroborative only. Full historical priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Orthogonal diagonal stretches with fixed positive parameters; uniformly oriented central plane and a uniformly distributed great-circle perturbation. No degenerate stretches, finite-angle transition formula, or uniform error estimate as axis ratios degenerate.
title: Stretch-invariant angular susceptibility of rhombic-dodecahedron central sections
